body:
## fix: guarantor fields accept browser autofill + autocomplete attribute audit

Fixes the reported bug: the Guarantor step's fields rejected browser autofill (the browser suggested entries but clicking them did not populate the fields).

### Root cause

Two layers, both verified in a real Chrome 150 against the actual form:

1. **Form-layer defect (fixed):** `form_fields.autocomplete_for` stamped `autocomplete="off"` — an explicit autofill opt-out — on every field outside an 8-name whitelist. All five guarantor fields hit that fallback, along with the references trios, work/income fields, and co-applicant cards. The sections that "worked" for the user (About You contact trio, Situation address quartet) were exactly the whitelisted ones.

2. **Chromium per-type fill cap (the real blocker, discovered in browser verification):** Chromium limits autofill to **9 fields per type per fill action** (`kTypeValueFormFillingLimit = 9`, `autofill_constants.h`), counted across the whole form in DOM order (`form_filler.cc` `GetFillingSkipReasonsForField`). The apply form legitimately contains 10 NAME_FULL / 11 PHONE / 11 EMAIL fields (About You + 3 reference trios + 3 co-applicant cards × employer/guarantor blocks). The primary guarantor block is the 10th/11th instance of each type, so Chrome suppresses its name/phone/email on **every** fill action — which reproduces the report exactly (other sections fill; the guarantor suggests but doesn't populate; `guarantor_employer` at COMPANY count 8 did fill). Field-by-field counts were confirmed against Chrome 150's `chrome://autofill-internals` fill records.

### The fix

- Every text field now maps to its standard WHATWG `autocomplete` token (exact-name table → suffix rules → `"off"` only for genuinely token-less fields: dates, counts, notes, honeypot). Bracket-prefixed names (`co_applicant[0][guarantor_name]`) normalize to their inner field name so one rule set covers both shapes.
- **Co-applicant phones use `tel-national`** — the one honest token lever against the cap: `tel` and `tel-national` are separate Chromium type buckets, so the split keeps every phone fillable (primary block at 5 `tel`, co-applicant blocks at 6 `tel-national`).

### Verification (real browser)

Chrome 150 + CDP `Autofill.setAddresses`/`Autofill.trigger` against the live form on a local Docker DB:

| Section | Before fix | After fix |
|---|---|---|
| About You (first/last/email/phone) | filled | filled |
| Situation address quartet | filled | filled |
| References landlord trio | filled | filled |
| **Guarantor phone** | **not filled** | **filled** ✓ |
| **Guarantor employer** | not filled | **filled** ✓ |
| Guarantor name / email | not filled | still suppressed by Chrome's 9-per-type cap (10th NAME_FULL / 11th EMAIL instance in the form — Chromium limit, not a form defect) |

Conditional show/hide unregressed: SSR pins + browser check (checkbox tick expands the fields; required cohorts render expanded with no checkbox; untick hides and clears).

### Decisions & rationale

- **`tel-national` on co-applicant phones:** national format is a legitimate standard phone token; the server's phone validation is non-empty only, so the filled format passes. This is the only standard-token lever against `kTypeValueFormFillingLimit`; without it the guarantor phone (one of the three fields in the report) never fills.
- **Guarantor name/email remain capped:** there are no alternative standard tokens for full-name/email fields. Fixing that would require a product decision (the three co-applicant cards are the multiplier — each card duplicates employer + guarantor contact blocks). Flagged for awareness; not something to restructure in a bugfix PR.
- **`autocomplete` on the honeypot and token-less fields stays `"off"`** deliberately — `off` is honest there.
- **No JS changes:** the condition engine, cohort module, and hidden-state logic are untouched (verified clean: they never clobber field values).

### Files changed

- `server/src/application/form_fields.gleam` — `autocomplete_for` rewrite (token mapping + `tel-national` split)
- `server/test/application/form_fields_test.gleam` — new: pins the token for every form field name (bare + bracketed)
- `server/test/application/guarantor_section_test.gleam` — pins rendered autocomplete attributes

### Checks

- `make format && make test && make build` — green (server 1219 unit + client/shared)
- `make test-integration` — 380 passed (local Docker Postgres 16)
- Real-browser autofill verification above (Chrome 150)
title: fix: guarantor fields accept browser autofill + autocomplete attribute audit
